doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Support multi-role assignment where users can hold multiple roles simultaneously (e.g., Admin + Village Head, Teacher + Farm Manager). Implement role-based access control (RBAC) where permissions are the union of all assigned roles. Manage storage quotas per user based on primary role (Admin: unlimited, Village Head: 20GB, Teachers: 5GB, Residents: 2GB, Learners: 1GB).

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a system administrator, I want a role-based permission system with multi-role support, so that users have appropriate access based on their village responsibilities. Includes 8 acceptance criteria covering role seeding, permission utilities, route guards, UI conditional rendering, and Appwrite permissions.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Centralized error handler composable (useErrorHandler) provides consistent error handling across the application. Handles Appwrite-specific errors including 401 (unauthorized), 403 (forbidden), 404 (not found). All permission errors should use this composable for consistent UX.

doc.title: Story 1.2: Appwrite Project Structure and Database Schema
doc.snippet: Created roles table with schema: id, name, permissions[], storage_quota, description, created_at. Created users table with role_ids[] field for multi-role assignment. Configured table-level permissions in Appwrite console.

doc.title: Story 1.3: Authentication System with Email/Password
doc.snippet: Implemented Pinia auth-store with user state management, login/logout functionality, and session checking. Created router-auth.js boot file with beforeEach navigation guard checking requiresAuth meta. All authentication flows use useErrorHandler for consistent error messaging.

node.package: Backend-as-a-Service SDK for database operations, authentication, and permissions
State management for storing user roles and permissions
Routing library for implementing route guards
Frontend framework for reactive UI and composables
UI framework providing components and utilities

interface.name: hasPermission
interface.signature: function hasPermission(user: User, requiredPermission: string): boolean
interface.description: Core permission checking function. Accepts user object with role_ids and a required permission string. Returns true if user has permission (via any assigned role), false otherwise. Handles wildcard permissions and pattern matching.

interface.name: usePermissions
interface.description: Vue composable wrapping permission utilities. Provides reactive permission checking functions for use in components. Automatically accesses current user from auth-store.

interface.name: router.beforeEach
interface.description: Vue Router navigation guard. Checks to.meta.requiresPermission and redirects unauthorized users to /unauthorized page. Integrates with hasPermission utility.

interface.name: Appwrite Databases.listDocuments
interface.description: Appwrite SDK method for querying roles table. Used to fetch role documents by role_ids array to calculate permission union.
